title: In-Person Hearing Days by Docket at the Unemployment Insurance Appeals Hearing Office
content:
Wednesday on the two employer dockets, Tuesday or Thursday on the Separation Issue and Able and Available Issue dockets: in-person sessions of Unemployment Insurance Appeals sit on fixed days on some dockets. Once the date for an in-person session has been found, the calendar-day rule moves it to a day on which the docket's in-person sessions sit.

**Rule.** On the Employer Contribution Rate and the Employer Benefit Charge dockets an in-person session date moves to the first Wednesday on or after the date found; on the Separation Issue and the Able and Available Issue dockets it moves to the first Tuesday or Thursday on or after that date; and on any other docket an in-person session date that falls on a Saturday or a Sunday moves to the following Monday.

## Days added, by weekday of the date found

| Weekday of the date found | Lower Authority Appeal — Employer Contribution Rate; Lower Authority Appeal — Employer Benefit Charge | Lower Authority Appeal — Separation Issue; Lower Authority Appeal — Able and Available Issue | Any other docket |
|---|---|---|---|
| Monday | 2 (to Wednesday) | 1 (to Tuesday) | 0 |
| Tuesday | 1 (to Wednesday) | 0 | 0 |
| Wednesday | 0 | 1 (to Thursday) | 0 |
| Thursday | 6 (to the next Wednesday) | 0 | 0 |
| Friday | 5 (to the next Wednesday) | 4 (to the next Tuesday) | 0 |
| Saturday | 4 (to Wednesday) | 3 (to Tuesday) | 2 (to Monday) |
| Sunday | 3 (to Wednesday) | 2 (to Tuesday) | 1 (to Monday) |

"On or after" includes the date found: a Wednesday stands on the two employer dockets, and a Tuesday or Thursday stands on the Separation Issue and Able and Available Issue dockets.

*Hypothetical dates found:* Thursday 7 May 2026 — Employer Contribution Rate: Wednesday 13 May; Separation Issue: Thursday 7 May stands; Overpayment and Fraud: Thursday 7 May stands. Sunday 10 May 2026 — Employer Benefit Charge: Wednesday 13 May; Able and Available Issue: Tuesday 12 May; Monetary Determination: Monday 11 May.
